response.sql: WITH funding_sources AS (SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(*) AS spatial_count, AVG(s.boxy / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), source_average AS (SELECT AVG(spatial_count) AS avg_count FROM funding_sources) SELECT AVG(f.avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio, SUM(f.spatial_count) AS total_spatial_count, AVG(f.spatial_count - a.avg_count) AS avg_count_excess FROM funding_sources AS f CROSS JOIN source_average AS a WHERE f.spatial_count > a.avg_count;
